heading_en: Assessment Horizon for Rating Assignment and Pool Allocation
summary_ja: 債務者格付の付与及びプールへの割当てにおける評価対象期間は一年以上とする。
summary_en: The assessment horizon for obligor ratings and pool allocation must be at least one year.

sections_en.第四節 第一款 第四目: Assessment Horizon for Assigning Obligor Ratings, etc.

paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall use an assessment horizon of at least one year for obligor ratings for corporate, etc. exposures and for the allocation of retail exposures to pools.
